# opalstack_app (Data Source)

Looks up an app by `id` or by `name`. Set `osuser_id` with `name` when the same name is used under more than one shell user.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "opalstack_app" "blog" {
  name = "blog"
}

output "blog_settings" {
  value = jsondecode(data.opalstack_app.blog.json)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) UUID of the app.
- `name` (String) Name of the app.
- `osuser_id` (String) UUID of the shell user the app belongs to. Narrows a lookup by `name`.

### Read-Only

- `installer_url` (String) URL of the installer script the app was created with, if any.
- `json` (String, Sensitive) The per-type settings of the app, as a JSON object. Decode it with `jsondecode`. Sensitive, because an installer can leave credentials among them.
- `osuser_name` (String) Name of the shell user the app belongs to.
- `port` (Number) Port assigned to the app, for the types that listen on one.
- `server_id` (String) UUID of the server the app runs on.
- `type` (String) Type of the app, such as `STA` or `CUS`.
